metaData.title: CCIG 2026 | TaoAvatar: Application of 3D Realistic Digital Humans in Taobao Vision
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This article is the full report presented by the Taotian Meta Technology Team at CCIG 2026, systematically introducing the TaoAvatar realistic digital human technology system based on 3D Gaussian Splatting, covering static modeling, drivable reconstruction, volumetric video, and its application in Taobao Vision.
metaData.summary: This article is the full text of an academic report invited by the Taotian Meta Technology Team at the China Conference on Image and Graphics (CCIG 2026). The article first outlines the diverse styles and application scenarios of digital humans, then details the three core capabilities of the TaoAvatar technology system: TaoModel (3DGS human body static modeling), TaoAvatar (3DGS drivable digital human reconstruction), and TaoVideo (4DGS human volumetric video). In the core technology section, the article elaborates on the realistic digital human technology framework based on 3D Gaussian Splatting, including realistic body and motion capture (based on SMPLX++ extension), realistic dynamic reconstruction (unified driving for multiple garments), and realistic speech-driven gesture algorithms (GestureDiT + LLM). The article also introduces the TaoVideo-4DGS volumetric video solution, which uses spline curves to describe Gaussian point motion and appearance, achieving complex dynamic effects. In terms of application, the article showcases the practices of Taobao Vision in its online App (winner of the Apple Design Awards) and offline future flagship stores, as well as brand collaborations such as the Berghaus virtual clothing store and the digital human for the Milan Winter Olympics uniforms. Finally, the article looks ahead to future technological evolution directions, including a low-cost digital human generation solution based on a single image/sparse views (FHAvatar), and introduces the team and recruitment information.

mainPoints.point: TaoAvatar is based on 3D Gaussian Splatting, achieving high-fidelity, drivable 3D realistic digital humans.
mainPoints.explanation: The solution integrates 3D Gaussian reconstruction, speech-driven lip sync, body pose and gesture driving, on-device real-time rendering, and an LLM inference engine, with core metrics reaching 2K resolution, 90 FPS real-time driving, production cost under 20,000 RMB, and delivery efficiency within one week.

mainPoints.point: Through the SMPLX++ extension and layered decoupled supervision, high-precision realistic body and motion capture is achieved.
mainPoints.explanation: Non-rigid deformation expressions for hair and clothing are added on top of SMPLX, employing a layered supervision strategy for face, hands, and body combined with a large and small studio setup, achieving an average PVE error of 6-7 mm, outperforming the open-source SOTA framework EasyMocap.

mainPoints.point: Upgrading from single-person, single-garment to single-ID, multi-garment unified modeling enables cross-garment unified driving.
mainPoints.explanation: By using human body part parsing and UV space to uniformly learn non-rigid deformations, different garments share weights. The deformations are ultimately baked into geometry and Gaussian deformation fields runnable on the device, with assets around 400 MB, achieving 90 FPS on the device.

mainPoints.point: The TaoVideo-4DGS solution does not rely on an explicit human model and can reconstruct complex dynamic effects for any garment.
mainPoints.explanation: It uses spline curves to describe the motion, appearance, and lifecycle of Gaussian points, and introduces non-uniform temporal control points to balance quality and storage, achieving a PSNR of 31-35 and on-device rendering at approximately 90 FPS.

mainPoints.point: Taobao Vision has achieved large-scale deployment in both its online App and offline flagship stores, and has won the Apple Design Awards.
mainPoints.explanation: The online App provides a 3D immersive shopping experience, while offline flagship stores integrate AI + 3D + XR technology, having opened in multiple cities. Collaborations with brands like Berghaus and the Milan Winter Olympics have validated the technology's commercial value.

keyQuotes: TaoAvatar is a 3D realistic digital human solution based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. It primarily addresses several typical issues in traditional 3D modeling, such as high computational cost, insufficient detail reconstruction, and difficulty in running on mobile devices.
It has evolved from training on 'single person, single garment, single action segment' to unified modeling of 'single ID, multiple garments, multiple actions'.

relatedArticles.title: In-Depth Analysis of AI-Generated UI Technology: Model Streaming Output and UI Rendering Practices
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically analyzes the core technologies of AI-Generated UI, focusing on the engineering practices of large language model streaming output and frontend UI rendering, covering streaming transmission protocols, mainstream open-source architectures, core challenges of streaming rendering, and AI editor implementations.

relatedArticles.title: 97.9% Acceptance Rate, Glue Programming: Best Practices for Business Requirement Code Generation [Tmall AI Coding Practice Series]
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: The Tmall team shares the 'Glue Programming' AI-assisted development methodology. By building a four-layer material system consisting of task specifications, development standards, code patterns, and domain knowledge, they have increased the business code acceptance rate to over 90%.

relatedArticles.title: Ctrip's James Liang × Luo Yonghao! Between Entrepreneur and Scholar, He Chose the Most Challenging 'Round-Trip Ticket'
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A three-hour in-depth dialogue systematically reviews the cross-border life of Ctrip founder James Liang, from child prodigy and Silicon Valley engineer to entrepreneur and economics PhD, delving into AI's impact on travel and education, remote work practices, and his profound concerns as a demographer about low fertility rates and national innovation competitiveness.

relatedArticles.title: #574. How to Create Truly Tasteful Products in the AI Era and Maintain Human Judgment in the Fast Software Wave
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tony Fadell, co-creator of the iPod, iPhone, and Nest, systematically shares his deep insights on product taste, systemic innovation, marketing storytelling, and the scarcity of 'human judgment' in the AI era.

relatedArticles.title: The AI Roll-Up That's Been Hot in Silicon Valley for a Year Is Turning 'Buying Companies' into a New AI Startup Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the emerging AI Roll-Up business model, which involves acquiring traditional service businesses (such as accounting, legal, and IT service firms) and radically transforming their operations with AI, examining its underlying economic model, driving factors, key players, industry landscape, and potential risks.

relatedArticles.title: Architecture Design for LLMs: What Makes a Truly AI-Friendly Architecture?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically elaborates on the three paradigms of evolution from traditional engineering architecture to AI-Friendly architecture (deterministic → probabilistic, structured → semantic, static → dynamic). It also provides a detailed explanation of core capabilities such as Multi-Agent, Context Engineering, AI-Friendly APIs, and AI Observability, using the practical implementation of AI review and Q&A systems in Taobao's flash sale business as a case study.

relatedArticles.title: Full-Stack RAG Technology Deep Dive
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically breaks down the core technologies of the full-stack RAG pipeline from a practical perspective, covering document loading, intelligent chunking, index construction, retrieval optimization, generation tuning, advanced Graph RAG, and the Ragas automated evaluation framework, emphasizing measurable, tunable, and trustworthy engineering practices.

relatedArticles.title: Just Now, Fei-Fei Li's World Model Open-Sourced a Rendering Powerhouse
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li, has open-sourced Spark 2.0, a Web renderer specifically built for 3D Gaussian Splatting, which enables streaming loading and rendering of ultra-large-scale, high-fidelity 3D scenes in browsers through Level of Detail, progressive streaming, and virtual memory technology.

relatedArticles.title: Envisioning the Possible Future of Multimodal Understanding: From Describing the World to Entering the World
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article explores the future evolution of multimodal understanding, arguing that it should progress from static, offline, question-answering capabilities to dynamic, online world-understanding systems with long-term memory and decision-making participation, and elaborates on six key trends: native multimodality, streaming video understanding, long-term memory, multimodal retrieval, serving as a judge for generative models, and spatial intelligence.

relatedArticles.title: Why Software Becomes Increasingly Complex: A Deep Dive into Software 'Complexity'
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article deeply analyzes the causes and manifestations of software complexity through e-commerce case studies, contrasts tactical and strategic programming, and systematically proposes practical methodologies for managing complexity via deep module design, information hiding, and proper abstraction.
